profile.name: Lakshmi Sravani Kondeti
profile.title: Full-Stack Developer & Data Science Graduate
profile.bio_short: Building scalable applications with React Native, FastAPI, and Spring Boot. Passionate about machine learning and creating meaningful solutions.
bio_long: Graduated with a Master's degree in Data Science & Analytics from Florida Atlantic University (May 2025, GPA: 3.63/4.0). I specialize in building robust, scalable applications using modern technologies like React Native, FastAPI, and Spring Boot.

With hands-on experience in both software development and machine learning, I've worked on projects ranging from mobile banking applications to fraud detection systems. I'm passionate about leveraging technology to solve real-world problems and creating intuitive user experiences.
Currently working as a React/React Native Developer at Worldwide Interactive Services, where I develop cross-platform banking solutions and analyze user behavior to improve application performance.

experience.description: Milly — OLB Browser Platform & Mobile Banking Application
highlights: Develop and maintain a full-featured browser and mobile banking platform live with 6,000+ active users, shipping monthly features and security releases since April 2026.
Built responsive UI screens using React, React Native, Expo Go, Tailwind, and NativeWind for registration, fund transfers, deposits, and bill payment flows.
Designed and implemented an end-to-end customer onboarding flow with real-time ID verification and remote deposit using MiSnap, ensuring secure user registration and check deposits.
Integrated the platform's bill pay module with iPay, supporting one-time and recurring bill payments, payee management, and payment status tracking across mobile and browser.
Built the eStatements feature enabling users to preview and download monthly statements for each individual card account, giving users self-service access to statement history.
Integrated Sentry for proactive error tracking and monitoring; the most recent monthly release measurably reduced client-reported bugs compared to the prior cycle.
Improved release stability by building an automated regression testing suite with Playwright, run ahead of every monthly deployment.
Maintained banking compliance standards across releases by auditing and updating project dependencies and security patches.
Analyzed user behavior and app performance metrics to identify usage patterns and guide UX improvements.

experience.description: FivePoints — CoBRIS App for Social Workers (completed, transitioned to client team)
highlights: Developed a cross-platform child welfare case management app (CoBRIS/Clover) using React Native, Expo, and TypeScript for Android and iOS from a single codebase.
Implemented secure token storage with silent JWT refresh and biometric re-authentication (Face ID, Fingerprint, PIN) via expo-local-authentication and expo-secure-store.
Built an offline-first architecture with a SecureStore-backed queue that auto-detects connectivity and flushes queued submissions once back online.

Implemented a persistent no-connectivity banner displayed across the screen to alert caseworkers in real time when the device lost network connection, reinforcing trust in the offline-first submission flow.
Engineered a session-timeout screen with live countdown, auto-biometric prompt, and graceful logout/re-authentication flow; configured Expo Router with protected routes and auth guards.
Delivered the completed application and handed off ownership to the FivePoints engineering team at project close.

experience.description: Fraud Detection System — State Co-operative Bank (Apache Fineract)
highlights: Engineered an ML-based fraud detection system to flag suspicious transactions, reducing manual review overhead and improving detection accuracy across multi-tenant bank deployments.
Built an end-to-end data pipeline using Python (pandas, scikit-learn) and SQL to analyze account data, detect fraud patterns, and identify customer anomalies.
Integrated trained ML models into a Spring Boot microservices backend with real-time fraud alert APIs and configurable detection rules per institution.
Delivered executive dashboards in Power BI and PostgreSQL, enabling compliance and risk teams to manage alerts across multiple bank clients.

projects.name: Mobile Banking App with AI Financial Advisor
projects.description: A full-stack, cross-platform mobile banking application featuring an AI-powered financial advisor, real-time budget tracking with push notifications, multi-account management, loan lifecycle management, and a global privacy mode — all backed by a production-grade .NET 9.0 RESTful API, Entity Framework Core, and PostgreSQL, containerized with Docker.
highlights: Architected a layered RESTful API with .NET 9.0 using a Controller → Service → Repository pattern across 8 controllers (Auth, Accounts, Transactions, Budgets, Loans, PaymentRequests, Users, AiAdvisor), covering the full banking domain: account management, credit/debit transactions with category tagging, monthly budget limits, loan applications with full lifecycle status tracking (Pending → Approved → Disbursed → Closed / Withdrawn), and full/partial bill payment processing.

Built a grounded AI financial advisor by integrating Amazon Bedrock's Converse API (Nova Lite model) with a dedicated FinancialContextService that aggregates a user's real account balances, last-3-month spending by category, and current-month budget utilization from PostgreSQL — passing a structured summary (never raw rows) to the model with a strict system prompt that prevents hallucination; the service supports a zero-cost mock mode for development.

Engineered a multi-layered security architecture: BCrypt password hashing (work factor 12) at registration, JWT Bearer authentication with strict token validation (issuer, audience, lifetime, zero clock skew), Expo SecureStore for on-device token persistence, HTTP security headers middleware (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection), and a global React context-based Privacy Mode that masks all monetary values app-wide with a single toggle, persisted across sessions via SecureStore.

Implemented idiomatic budget and loan business logic: an upsert pattern in BudgetService that creates or updates a monthly limit for a given category in a single operation (preventing duplicate records), real-time CurrentSpending tracking that auto-updates on every categorized debit transaction, and a soft-withdraw workflow for pending loan applications that validates ownership and status before transitioning to a Withdrawn state — keeping audit history intact.

Designed a rich, data-driven mobile UI with NativeWind (Tailwind CSS for React Native) and Expo Router: an interactive pie chart (built with react-native-svg) that renders per-category spending slices with tap-to-expand detail, sparkline trend charts showing monthly spending history per category, color-coded category progress bars with over-budget warnings, and in-app push notifications (via Expo Notifications) for budget threshold alerts (≥ 80% used), large transaction detection (> $200), and upcoming loan payment reminders (within 3 days of due date).

projects.name: Zest Kid — Kids Activity Marketplace
projects.description: A cross-platform Flutter marketplace connecting parents with independent class vendors and coaches — handling multi-tenant scheduling, class bookings, Stripe-integrated payments, and a financial dashboard, built with Claude as an AI development partner throughout.
highlights: Architected the full backend on Supabase: Postgres database with Row Level Security for multi-tenant data isolation, Storage for media uploads, and Auth for role-based user management (parents, vendors, coaches).
Integrated Stripe Connect end-to-end: PaymentIntents for class bookings, automated platform revenue splits, and recurring subscription billing for business accounts.
Deployed Supabase Edge Functions (TypeScript/Deno) to handle payment processing and Stripe webhook events server-side, keeping credentials off the client.
Implemented a financial dashboard with monthly earnings summaries, revenue-by-class breakdowns, and Stripe Connect payout management for vendors.
Followed TDD across auth, classes, payments, subscriptions, and booking flows using flutter_test and mocktail, covering controllers, repositories, CSV parsing logic, and key UI screens.
Currently demoing the platform to prospective business clients and iterating the roadmap based on their feedback.

projects.name: RAGBot — Full-Stack RAG Application
projects.description: Full-stack Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application enabling document-grounded question answering with source citations using LangChain, ChromaDB, and the Claude API.
highlights: Architected a full-stack RAG pipeline using LangChain, ChromaDB, and the Claude API (Anthropic), enabling document-grounded question answering with source citations.

Designed document ingestion pipeline with overlapping chunk splitting (1,000 chars, 200 char overlap) and Claude embeddings stored in a persistent ChromaDB vector collection for accurate semantic retrieval.
Engineered retrieval strategy to fetch the top 4 most semantically similar chunks at query time, assembled into a structured context prompt sent to Claude for grounded, hallucination-reduced answers.

Built multi-modal ingestion supporting PDF uploads, plain text files, and live URL scraping via a FastAPI backend; implemented collapsible source citations (filename + excerpt) in the React/TypeScript frontend.
Secured the API with JWT authentication (bcrypt), guest access via browser-generated IDs, and persistent multi-session chat history.

projects.name: Claude Multi-Agent Dev System
projects.description: Multi-agent Claude Code setup with 6 specialized skills for planning, architecture, implementation, review, and testing — demonstrated end-to-end by building a production-grade JWT authentication API entirely through the agent workflow.
highlights: Designed a 6-agent orchestration system (task-planner, architecture-agent, coding-agent, code-assistant, code-reviewer, testing-expert) with an enforced workflow order to mirror real engineering team practices.

Built a production-grade Fastify JWT auth API (register, login, refresh, logout, /me) as a live demonstration of the agent pipeline, with httpOnly refresh token rotation and in-memory revocation store.
Documented all architectural decisions as ADRs (ADR-001 through ADR-006), covering session store abstraction, revocation store, JSON Schema validation, and per-route rate limiting.
Achieved 70 Jest tests across 4 suites covering unit and integration scenarios for auth endpoints, session store, and revocation store.
Implemented rate limiting on /register, /login, and /refresh using @fastify/rate-limit, and JSON Schema input validation via Fastify's built-in schema support.

projects.name: Team Task Allocator
projects.description: Full-stack task management system built with React and ASP.NET Core where managers create and assign tasks to employees, with role-based dashboards, employee search by name or skill, and a calendar view for deadline tracking — built end-to-end using a 6-agent Claude Code workflow.
highlights: Implemented role-based JWT authentication (manager / employee) with claims extracted server-side, preventing privilege escalation on task creation.
Built a PostgreSQL-backed employee search using a GIN-indexed TEXT[] skills column and trigram index on name, enabling efficient server-side filtering by name or skill without in-memory joins.
Applied a strict Repository → Service → Controller layering (ADR-documented) keeping DbContext out of controllers and making the service layer fully unit-testable via mocked repositories.
Delivered separate React dashboards per role: managers get task creation with live employee search, employees get a list and FullCalendar calendar view of assigned tasks by deadline.
Developed using a structured 6-agent Claude Code workflow (task-planner → architecture-agent → coding-agent → code-reviewer → testing-expert), with all architectural decisions recorded as ADRs.
